messages:
Alice: heads-up: planning a config-only deploy tonight in the 22:00 UTC change window. this is routing + batching param adjustments, no model changes. will canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% and watch P95 + error-rate.

DeployBot: Received deploy request: config-only slate 'routing-batch-slate-2026-03' by Alice. change_window=2026-03-21T22:00Z. rollout: 5%,25%,100%. id=cfg-1776549999.

Ben: can you paste exact diff? particularly timeouts and micro-batching values. need to know DB pool risk.

Alice: small tidy, lowering default request_timeout_ms and shrinking micro_batch_size on chat routes. also tighten fallback routing weight. diff below:

```yaml
routing:
  prefer_local: true
  fallback_weight: 0.65
timeouts_ms:
  default: 6200
  health_probe: 900
batching:
  micro_batch: 10
  kvcache_ttl_s: 60
```

Chandra: sounds OK. define rollback triggers: P95 >= +25% vs baseline (7d avg) OR 5m error rate >= 1%. want explicit rollback commands in thread.

Alice: rollback procedures: 1) immediate: `/deploybot rollback cfg-1776549999` to restore prior config. 2) if deploybot unavailable: use route-pin service to pin traffic to previous routing config. alerting: route-p95-spike (25%), route-errorrate (1%).

Marta: i'll monitor first two canary steps. if P95 climbs +15% on canary cohort i'll hit rollback right away. @Chandra pls watch DB connections and kvcache miss spikes.

obs-bot: Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/routing/overview?var-slate=routing-batch-slate-2026-03
Alerts: route-p95-spike (25%), route-errorrate (1%). paging set to oncall-sre.

default-monitoring: added tenant_exclude for first canary to avoid tenants with strict floors: enterprise-acme, gov-uk.

Ben: good call on excludes. also note a few tenants have strict session timeouts; excluded in canary is necessary.

DeployBot: Canary step 1 (5%) started for cfg-1776549999 at 1776550200.

Marta: 5% stage looks clean after 6m. no increase in errors, p95 stable.

Chandra: watching kvcache_hit_rate and DB pool. hit rate down ~1.5% but expected; DB connections flat. no action.

DeployBot: Canary step 2 (25%) started at 1776550500.

Marta: 25% steady at 10m check. no tenants reporting issues. planning 100% in 12m unless objections.

Ben: +1. anyone else? :thumbsup:

Alice: kicking final ramp now. post-deploy watch for 1h. handover to SRE for 60m.

DeployBot: Rollout complete: cfg-1776549999 deployed to 100% at 1776550800. No automatic rollbacks triggered.

Marta: adding release note: config-only change: default timeout 7.2s -> 6.2s, micro_batch 16 -> 10, fallback_weight tightened 0.8 -> 0.65. will publish to release channel.

Alice: thanks team. if anything odd appears i'll pin back or run rollback manually. ping #eng-oncall for fast escalation.
